experiment_blueprint.freeze_rule: Freeze method hash, split hash, metric/taxonomy, prompt/tool policy, and experiment-blueprint hash before any full experiment.

experimental_integrity.model_and_inference: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, deterministic decoding, react-family ALFWorld scaffold, max_steps=50; model/checkpoint frozen per run.
experimental_integrity.prompt_tool_policy: Prompt patches, injected faults, tool/workflow wrappers, and allowed repair surfaces are versioned; hidden labels are never placed in prompts.
experimental_integrity.task_sample_split: Discovery/development and sealed held-out task files are frozen before result inspection; no task moves after launch.
experimental_integrity.metric_analysis_plan: Primary metric: held-out frozen-observer fault localization accuracy/AUROC at matched utility; report per-unit/family outcomes before macro aggregation and compare strongest same-information baselines.
experimental_integrity.randomness_replication_plan: Local P0 uses seed 42 deterministic generation; threshold-near cases may repeat <=3 times only under the frozen rule. Full experiments require >=3 seeds.
experimental_integrity.stopping_exclusion_rules: Runtime/implementation invalid rows are excluded with explicit typed status; no performance-based row exclusion. Budget stop cannot register a method result.
experimental_integrity.allowed_adaptations: Only execution/runtime repair that leaves the frozen method, tasks, metrics, baselines, and analysis unchanged; core changes require a new Paper Design Contract.
experimental_integrity.hidden_evaluation_access_policy: No web search, benchmark solution lookup, hidden-label inspection, or evaluator introspection during execution; search trajectory is disabled for local P0.

claims.statement: Updates with similar utility can differ in how well future failures remain externally diagnosable.
claims.why_better_or_why_matters: The registered mechanism should retain decision-relevant information that Task regression + trace completeness and observability-only optimization under the same probes discards.
alternative_explanations: Any apparent gain is explained by extra information or interaction budget rather than the proposed mechanism.
A direct aggregate-utility rule or shallow same-feature model absorbs the apparent gain.
ruling_out_experiments: Match observable information, candidate set, environment interactions, and model calls against the strongest simplification.
Remove the core novelty-carrying component while keeping the rest of the pipeline fixed.

baselines.purpose: Test whether the proposed mechanism leaves residual value beyond Task regression + trace completeness and observability-only optimization under the same probes.
Test whether direct aggregate utility or a best-fixed policy explains the result without the proposed mechanism.
Test whether a shallow same-feature predictor absorbs the apparent mechanism gain.

ablations.purpose: Remove the novelty-carrying component (diagnosability-preserving commit constraint) while preserving all other information and compute.
ablations.decision_rule: The claimed mechanism is unsupported if removing the core component does not reduce the preregistered held-out advantage on disagreement cases.

ablations.purpose: Replace the registered mechanism quantity with direct aggregate utility/risk while preserving the surrounding pipeline.
ablations.decision_rule: If the aggregate proxy matches the full method within uncertainty, narrow the claim to the simpler representation or merge the method.

analyses.purpose: Show that gains concentrate on preregistered cases where the mechanism predicts a different decision from the strongest simplification.
analyses.decision_rule: Report agreement and disagreement strata separately; no mechanism claim from aggregate improvement alone.

analyses.purpose: Rule out extra information, extra calls, or direct aggregate utility as the source of the result.
analyses.decision_rule: Any unmatched information/budget advantage invalidates an algorithmic-superiority interpretation.

analyses.purpose: Characterize where the mechanism fails, ties the baseline, or becomes non-identifiable.
analyses.decision_rule: Publish failure strata and typed inconclusive cases rather than deleting them from the main evidence chain.

analyses.purpose: Test whether the conclusion survives preregistered task-family, seed, threshold, and support-definition changes.
analyses.decision_rule: A claim that only survives one unregistered setting is narrowed to that setting.

analyses.purpose: Quantify stochastic and sampling uncertainty for every headline comparison.
analyses.decision_rule: Main comparative claims require paired uncertainty intervals or a preregistered exact/randomization test, not point estimates alone.

planned_outputs.purpose: Headline matched baseline table with primary metric, uncertainty, and cost.
Explicit component/representation ablation table, not buried in prose.
Why/where it works: disagreement-stratified mechanism figure or table.

visualizations.reviewer_question: Does the full method beat the strongest same-information baseline, and is the gap larger than its uncertainty?
visualizations.takeaway: Show matched baselines, primary effect, uncertainty, and cost in one comparison rather than a bare headline number.

visualizations.reviewer_question: Which novelty-carrying component is actually necessary?
visualizations.takeaway: Expose the marginal contribution of the core mechanism and the aggregate-proxy replacement under matched information and compute.

visualizations.reviewer_question: Why and where does the mechanism help, tie, fail, or become non-identifiable?
visualizations.takeaway: Place mechanism-predicted disagreement strata beside failure and inconclusive regimes so aggregate gains cannot hide the boundary.

visualizations.reviewer_question: Does the conclusion survive the preregistered task, seed, threshold, and support perturbations?
visualizations.takeaway: Show the stable region and any boundary where the paper claim must narrow.

assumptions.statement: The local substrate contains enough effect variation to identify the registered quantity.
assumptions.observable_check: F0 support counts and target/effect variation.

assumptions.statement: Environment/fault truth is independent of the method decision rule.
assumptions.observable_check: sealed task/fault labels and same-information baseline audit.

principle_certificate.mechanism: An agent should not purchase current capability by consuming the evidence needed to diagnose its next failure.

predictions.statement: Candidate updates can change external fault-cause separability independently of task utility.
predictions.observable: frozen-observer cause localization accuracy/AUROC and provenance coverage at matched task utility

predictions.statement: A diagnosability constraint rejects updates that preserve/improve utility but cause measurable future diagnosis degradation, and the degradation predicts repair difficulty.

operationalization.measure: frozen-observer cause localization accuracy/AUROC and provenance coverage at matched task utility
operationalization.validity_check: Use the shared controlled-fault table to freeze a simple diagnostic observer on development tasks and test post-update cause localization on held-out tasks.

operationalization.measure: same-information disagreement plus held-out outcome difference
operationalization.validity_check: compare against Task regression + trace completeness and observability-only optimization under the same probes.

falsification.contradiction_rule: Stop if diagnosability changes are fully explained by trace length/completeness or do not predict downstream repair cost/accuracy.

failure_update_rules.execution-invalid: repair execution only; preserve the scientific contract and do not update principle belief
failure_update_rules.design-nonidentifiable: repair substrate/task/variation so the principle becomes testable; do not register a principle negative
failure_update_rules.operationalization-failure: repair the measurement, representation, or objective bridge before retesting the same principle
failure_update_rules.assumption-violation: revise the omitted assumption or scope condition, derive a new prediction, and keep the core mechanism unresolved
failure_update_rules.matched-simplification: weaken or merge the current method realization/novelty claim; do not automatically reject the broader principle
failure_update_rules.registered-prediction-contradicted: only after all falsification preconditions hold may the registered principle prediction be rejected

hidden_evaluation_sealed.evidence: Local validation freezes task/fault splits before metric inspection; held-out cases are never used to construct candidate repairs or thresholds.

evaluation_artifacts_inaccessible.evidence: Environment success labels and held-out fault ownership are withheld from the policy/update generator; only the independent analyzer sees them.

independent_truth_source.evidence: ALFWorld environment execution and preregistered controlled-fault labels define truth; the evolving agent never grades itself.

same_information_baselines.evidence: Matched baselines receive identical tasks, candidate updates/fault traces, calls, held-out budget, and observable features.

claim_metric_alignment.evidence: Primary metrics directly instantiate the registered paper claim and are frozen before local validation.

versioned_evaluator.evidence: Config hash, source commit, task split, parser, failure taxonomy, and analysis code are versioned in each run manifest.

shortcut_audit.evidence: Hidden answer/benchmark lookup, fault metadata leakage to the router, post-hoc split changes, and cached hidden outcomes are forbidden.

updater_competence.reason: Frozen shared F0/P0-Support passed the preregistered support gate. This qualifies the local support substrate but is not a METHOD-PASS.
updater_competence.scientific_role: hard prerequisite before Gate 1; failure blocks this local realization without rejecting the paper problem
